body.statement: For every \(n\) with \(T_n>K\) and \(\delta_{q,n}\le c/4\), there is an extension of the randomization probability space carrying \(Z_{r,\bar q}\) such that \(\Pr(G_n^c\cup\{|S_n-Z_{r,\bar q}|>4h_n\})\le D_{\mathrm{tr},n}\), where every term of \(D_{\mathrm{tr},n}\) is the declared computable budget and \(D_{\mathrm{tr},n}\to0\) uniformly over all experiments satisfying the declared assumptions.
body.justification: The explicit stopped coupling is the theorem-level bridge from adaptive finite experiments to an atomic signed critical law.
body.gap: LiZhao2026 derives a martingale CLT under Lindeberg, while BarbourXia1999 treats integer-valued compound-Poisson approximation; neither covers predictable stopping with real signed residual marks and this finite error allocation.
body.consumer: Any fixed-horizon adaptive trial whose logged probabilities and expected-endpoint bridge satisfy the declared moduli receives an auditable non-Gaussian calibration error.
